packages.label: אֱמֶת וּצְדָקָה וְשֶׁמֶשׁ
packages.reason: These five nodes all share the same essential nature: they are different faces of the single, unified force of divine truth (אמת). The Torah teaches that צדקה is a bechina of אמת because truth is singular and so is charity — both have no multiplicity or falsehood. שמש is a bechina of אמת because the sun is one undivided power and change occurs only in its receivers, not in the sun itself — exactly as God's truth is unchanging and the variation lies only with those who receive it. יעקב is a bechina of אמת because the verse explicitly states 'תתן אמת ליעקב'. The 'man of complete mitzvot' is a bechina of אמת because his inner and outer behavior are identical — no gap between public and private, which is the very definition of truth. All five nodes express the same quality: wholeness, unity, the absence of internal contradiction or falsehood.
nodes: שעושה מצוות בשלמות ובכל הדקדוקים בינו לבין קונו כמו שמדקדק לעשות המצוה בפני בני אדם
